title: Slim the plugin task workflow and close its gaps
goal: Cut the fixed token cost of every plugin pipeline session (CLAUDE.md, delivery.md, prompts that invite reading the policy) without losing a rule, and add what the flow lacks: a plugin review checklist, a base-health check, a run cost ledger, a learning-loop step and a tier XS fast path for small prose changes.

tasks.grade_reason: changes a deliberate policy marker, tier logic, validate and gate acceptance; gate regressions are costly
tasks.objective: User decision 2026-11-10: add tier XS. A tiny change still costs ~4 sessions today (run lead, task lead, implementer, reviewer). XS: every owned path is prose (scripts/lib/pipeline_route.py prose_path) and the change is within a registry threshold (registry/core.json pipeline.tiers.XS: max_files 3, max_changed_lines 40, contracts false, generated false; mirror in skills/delivery/pipeline-defaults.json; registry.json rebuilt with python3 -B scripts/build-registry.py; docs/registry.schema.json). Flow: the run lead writes a one-task plan with tier XS, edits the files itself on the plan topic branch, commits with explicit paths, then dispatches one cross-model review (dispatch --phase review --sha <sha>; the implementer recorded as the run lead's model) and runs the task QA tier command itself, recording 'verdict --phase qa --state PASS --by <lead model> --note "tier XS: lead ran task suites"'. No task lead, no task worktree, no implement session. Code: 'tier' prints XS when it applies; 'validate' accepts a one-task XS plan and rejects XS when a path is not prose, more than one task, or a threshold is exceeded; 'dispatch --phase lead' on an XS task says the run lead edits it and prints the review command; 'dispatch --phase review' works without a task worktree for XS (reads the topic checkout); 'gate' accepts the XS review plus the lead-run QA and blocks when the committed diff exceeds the thresholds. Policy: the '<!-- policy:run-lead-never-implements -->' sentence gains the XS exception (update its mutation case in tests/parallel-policy.test.sh), delivery.md section 1 and section 10 step 1 and the QA tiers table name XS, factory-core SKILL.md step 6 names XS (one line each). Tests in tests/pipeline.test.sh: XS tier printed, XS plan validates, non-prose path never XS, oversize diff never XS (validate and gate), gate READY_FOR_PR for an XS task with review PASS and lead QA.
